🧠 US HR 10648 — VA Promises 24-Hour Mental Health Treatment

This bill directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to provide inpatient mental health treatment to veterans through the Veterans Community Care Program.

The VA must offer care within 24 hours of a veteran requesting it or a doctor prescribing it.

The VA will also track and report on wait times for this care every six months, publishing the data on its website.

Oct. 14, 2026: Referred to the Subcommittee on Health.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/10648
